articles.title_en: The Broad Decline in Health and Human Capital of Americans Born after 1947
articles.title_cn: 1947年后出生美国人的健康与人力资本广泛下降
articles.abstract_en: I present evidence of a cross-cohort decline in the health and human capital of Americans, beginning with those born after 1947 and continuing until those born in the mid-1960s. Education, men’s wages, women’s maternal health (proxied by their infants’ birth weight), and mortality all exhibit trend breaks near the 1947 cohort, such that each outcome worsens for subsequent cohorts relative to prior trend. The decline is large enough to drive educational declines in the 1960s, increases in low birth weight in the 1980s, and mortality increases since 1999 and to contribute substantially to wage stagnation since the 1970s. (JEL I12, I26, J13, J16, J24, J31)
articles.abstract_cn: 我提供了美国人健康与人力资本跨队列下降的证据，这一下降始于1947年后出生的人群，并持续至1960年代中期出生的人群。教育、男性工资、女性孕产妇健康（以婴儿出生体重为代理指标）以及死亡率均在1947年队列附近出现趋势断裂，使得后续队列的每项结果相对于先前趋势均有所恶化。这一下降幅度足以推动1960年代教育水平的下降、1980年代低出生体重率的上升、1999年以来死亡率的增加，并对1970年代以来的工资停滞产生显著贡献。（JEL I12, I26, J13, J16, J24, J31）

articles.title_en: How Do Entrants Build Market Share? The Role of Demand Frictions
articles.title_cn: 进入者如何建立市场份额？需求摩擦的作用
articles.abstract_en: We construct a new dataset to show that successful entrants in the consumer food sector build market share by adding new customers. Entrants reach new customers by entering more geographical markets, placing their product in more stores in these markets, and, for a positively selected subset of firms, advertising directly to customers. These activities are costly and are associated with persistent increases in quantities, but there are no differences in markups between new and mature markets. This confirms a central role for marketing and advertising in overcoming demand-side frictions that slow firm growth. (JEL D24, D25, L11, L25, L81, M13, M37)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个新数据集，以显示消费品食品行业中成功的进入者通过增加新客户来建立市场份额。进入者通过进入更多地理市场、在这些市场的更多商店中投放产品，以及对于正向选择的子集企业，直接向客户做广告来接触新客户。这些活动成本高昂，并与数量的持续增长相关，但新市场与成熟市场之间的加成率没有差异。这证实了营销和广告在克服阻碍企业增长的需求侧摩擦方面发挥核心作用。(JEL D24, D25, L11, L25, L81, M13, M37)

articles.title_cn: 劳动力市场力量与发展
articles.abstract_en: Imperfect competition in labor markets can lead to efficiency losses and lower aggregate output. This paper examines how variations in labor market competitiveness may account for differences in GDP per capita among countries. By structurally estimating an oligop-sony model with free entry across different development stages, we find that labor market power increases with GDP per capita. Wage markdowns vary from 54 percent in low-income countries to around 24 percent in the richest ones. If labor markets in poorer countries were as competitive as in more developed ones, their output per capita could rise by up to 44 percent. (JEL E23, J22, J31, J42, L13, L25, O47)
articles.abstract_cn: 劳动力市场的不完全竞争可能导致效率损失和总产出下降。本文考察了劳动力市场竞争性的差异如何解释各国人均GDP的差异。通过在不同发展阶段结构性地估计一个具有自由进入的寡头垄断模型，我们发现劳动力市场力量随人均GDP增加而增强。工资加价折扣从低收入国家的54%变化到最富裕国家的约24%。如果较贫穷国家的劳动力市场像较发达国家那样具有竞争性，其人均产出可能上升高达44%。（JEL E23, J22, J31, J42, L13, L25, O47）

articles.title_cn: 风险世界中的可持续性
articles.abstract_en: How much consumption is sustainable, if “sustainability” requires that welfare should not be expected to decline over time? We impose a sustainability constraint on a standard consumption/portfolio choice problem. The constraint does not distort portfolio choice, but it imposes an upper bound on the sustainable consumption-wealth ratio, which must lie between the riskless interest rate and the expected return on wealth (and if risky capital evolves according to a geometric Brownian motion, it lies exactly halfway between the two). Sustainability requires an upward drift in wealth and consumption to compensate future generations for the increased risk they face. (JEL D63, D81, E21, G51, H43, Q01)
articles.abstract_cn: 如果“可持续性”要求福利不应预期随时间下降，那么多少消费是可持续的？我们在一个标准的消费/投资组合选择问题上施加了可持续性约束。该约束不会扭曲投资组合选择，但它对可持续消费-财富比率施加了一个上限，该比率必须介于无风险利率和财富的预期回报之间（如果风险资本遵循几何布朗运动，则恰好位于两者中间）。可持续性要求财富和消费向上漂移，以补偿未来世代所面临的增加的风险。（JEL D63, D81, E21, G51, H43, Q01）

articles.title_cn: 信息获取与时间风险偏好
articles.abstract_en: An agent acquires information dynamically until her belief about a binary state reaches an upper or lower threshold. She can choose any signal process subject to a constraint on the rate of entropy reduction. Strategies are ordered by “time risk”—the dispersion of the distribution of threshold-hitting times. We construct a strategy maximizing time risk (Greedy Exploitation) and one minimizing it (Pure Accumulation). Under either, beliefs follow a compensated Poisson process. In the former, beliefs jump to the threshold closer in Bregman divergence. In the latter, beliefs jump to the unique point with the same entropy as the current belief. (JEL D81, D82, D83)
articles.abstract_cn: 一个代理人动态地获取信息，直到她对二元状态的信念达到上阈值或下阈值。她可以选择任何信号过程，但受限于熵减少率的约束。策略按“时间风险”——阈值到达时间分布的离散程度——进行排序。我们构建了一个最大化时间风险的策略（贪婪利用）和一个最小化时间风险的策略（纯积累）。在任一策略下，信念遵循补偿泊松过程。在前者中，信念跳跃到Bregman散度上更接近的阈值。在后者中，信念跳跃到与当前信念具有相同熵的唯一一点。（JEL D81, D82, D83）

articles.title_en: Building Nondiscriminatory Algorithms in Selected Data
articles.title_cn: 在选择性数据中构建无歧视算法
articles.abstract_en: We develop new quasi-experimental tools to understand algorithmic discrimination and build nondiscriminatory algorithms when the outcome of interest is only selectively observed. We first show that algorithmic discrimination arises when the available algorithmic inputs are systematically different for individuals with the same objective potential outcomes. We then show how algorithmic discrimination can be eliminated by measuring and purging these conditional input disparities. Leveraging the quasi-random assignment of bail judges in New York City, we find that our new algorithms not only eliminate algorithmic discrimination but also generate more accurate predictions by correcting for the selective observability of misconduct outcomes. (JEL C51, J15, K41, K42)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发了新的准实验工具，以理解算法歧视，并在感兴趣的结果仅被选择性观测时构建无歧视算法。我们首先表明，当可用的算法输入对于具有相同客观潜在结果的个体存在系统性差异时，算法歧视便会出现。接着，我们展示了如何通过测量并消除这些条件输入差异来消除算法歧视。利用纽约市保释法官的准随机分配，我们发现我们的新算法不仅消除了算法歧视，而且通过纠正不当行为结果的选择性可观测性，生成了更准确的预测。(JEL C51, J15, K41, K42)

articles.title_en: Growth and Redistribution: The Hedging Perspective
articles.title_cn: 增长与再分配：对冲视角
articles.abstract_en: We investigate the impact of wealth redistribution on economic growth, building on Kelly’s (1956) optimal investment portfolio theory. A growth-optimal policy redistributes wealth from “lucky” overperforming individuals to underperforming ones, minimizing the systematic component of this redistribution in a myopic fashion. That is, the optimal policy minimizes the discrepancy between endowments and outcomes, counterfactually taking outcomes as independent of endowments. The myopia in this result follows from a decoupling argument that allows us to model the planner as independently choosing a growth-maximizing policy and a pattern of wealth circulation. (JEL D31, E23, G41, G51, H23, O41)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们基于凯利（1956）的最优投资组合理论，研究财富再分配对经济增长的影响。增长最优政策将财富从“幸运”的超额表现者再分配给表现不佳者，以近视方式最小化这种再分配的系统性成分。也就是说，最优政策最小化禀赋与结果之间的差异，反事实地将结果视为独立于禀赋。这一结果的近视性源于一种解耦论证，该论证允许我们将规划者建模为独立选择增长最大化政策和财富循环模式。（JEL D31, E23, G41, G51, H23, O41）

articles.title_en: Regional Dissent: Do Local Economic Conditions Influence FOMC Votes?
articles.title_cn: 区域异议：地方经济状况是否影响FOMC投票？
articles.abstract_en: US monetary policy decisions are made by the 12 voting members of the FOMC, seven of which inherently represent national-level interests. The remaining members, a rotating group of presidents from the 12 Federal Reserve districts, come instead from subnational jurisdictions. Does this structure have implications for the monetary policymaking process? We provide novel evidence that regional economic conditions influence the voting behavior of district presidents. Specifically, a regional unemployment rate that is 1 percentage point higher than the national level is associated with an approximately 9 percentage point higher probability of dissenting in favor of looser policy at the FOMC. (JEL E24, E32, E43, E52, E58)
articles.abstract_cn: 美国货币政策决策由FOMC的12名投票成员做出，其中七名本质上代表国家层面的利益。其余成员，即来自12个联邦储备区的轮换行长群体，则来自次国家辖区。这种结构是否对货币政策制定过程产生影响？我们提供了新的证据表明，区域经济状况影响地区行长的投票行为。具体而言，当区域失业率比全国水平高出1个百分点时，在FOMC上支持更宽松政策的异议概率大约增加9个百分点。（JEL E24, E32, E43, E52, E58）
